title: Two-cell MF6 realization of post-allocation groundwater transfer into real RibaMod

relation_to_20e2.preserved_science: same Ribasim topology, same daily allocation, same intended groundwater arrival after 6 h, same root-first management hypothesis
relation_to_20e2.changed_representation: replace one cell carrying both CHD and DRN by separate CHD source cell and active DRN cell

cell_1.role: active groundwater cell carrying the sole DRN boundary

analytical_postactivation_steady_referen.note: Storage relaxation time is negligible relative to the 6 h product step; exact runtime flux is still measured and qualified, not assumed.

idealized_transfer_reference.meaning: Same prospectively derived physical target as DUMMY-20E2; the two-cell MF6 analytical flux differs from 8 m3/day by only about 1.28e-4 m3/day.

hypotheses: The first 0-6 h MF6 DRN flux is zero because the active-cell drain elevation equals the initial/support head.
After 6 h, the separate active DRN cell produces a nonzero drainage flux of approximately 7.999872 m3/day rather than the zero flux observed in DUMMY-20E2.
RibaMod transfers that MF6 DRN flux reciprocally into Ribasim Basin drainage.
Ribasim cumulative groundwater transfer is approximately 2, 4 and 6 m3 at 12, 18 and 24 h.
The daily t=0 root-first allocation remains frozen during day 1, so external UserDemand remains unsupplied.
Groundwater arriving after the t=0 allocation changes Basin storage and root physical realization without retroactively reallocating management.
The coupled source + groundwater = UserDemand + Basin-storage ledger closes at every accepted boundary.
forbidden: no use of DUMMY-20E2 no-exchange observations as treated reference
no change to Ribasim allocation.dt, saveat, demand or priorities
no active drain on the CHD cell itself
no post-output tuning of idealized physical references
